| **wave-curve** | 15 + 5 wave rule and the per-biome difficulty curve | cline | code | 2 | M | Waves are a rule now (15 in stage 1, +5 a stage, in every biome) and the ramp is per biome: 1.00 on wave 1 everywhere, rising to the region's curve_end on the last wave, bent quadratically because money grows with the square of the wave. This replaced 2^(wave/5-2) + 0.2(w-1), which hit x1036 at wave 60. |
| **difficulty-wiring** | Make the difficulty columns actually change the fight | cline | code | 2 | M | difficulty_current() had zero callers, so Normal / Hard / Brutal differed only in payout. hp, speed, count, money and the starting-money column are now read where they belong. |
